findingA_BrowserGameplayTest.details: Test manually assigns s.opponent.field = [oppTargetSpirit, oppIllegalSpirit], manually filters legal candidates (bp <= 2000), directly calls window.BattleArena.promptStructuredDecision, manually removes target from field, and manually increments s.opponent.trash.

findingB_OpcodeSemanticEvidence.details: Opcode verification status determined purely by regex string matching: files searched for case '${code}': and tests searched for literal string ['"]${code}['"]. Handler presence + string match was treated as SEMANTICALLY_VERIFIED without runtime execution.

findingC_MasterTestRunner.details: Discovered test files not configured in MASTER_SUITES were assigned disposition STANDALONE_VERIFIED by default without actually executing them or verifying test pass counts.

findingD_CardSupportMatrix.details: Supported abilities counts were determined by handler presence in ops engine rather than verified runtime execution evidence.

findingE_CardCorpusReconciliation.details: All figures mathematically reconciled: 14,443 detailed, 14,609 unique shard cards, 15,398 shard instances, 514 shards, 36,422 abilities, 51,734 clauses, 288 unique opcodes. SQLite cards_v2 count of 14,611 explained by 2 composite IDs.
